source_title: Pokemon TCG Officially Reveals Special New Rayquaza Release
source_excerpt:
The Pokemon TCG has officially revealed a brand-new Rayquaza-themed Premium Tournament Collection, featuring promo cards, exclusive card sleeves, and plenty of packs. Mega Rayquaza serves as the spotlight Pokemon for the Pokemon TCG 's next major set, Delta Reign.
The trading card game branch of the beloved monster-catching franchise has delivered plenty of exciting releases in 2026. The Pokemon TCG kicked off the year with the highly-anticipated Ascended Heroes set, which broke the record for the largest Pokemon set of all time. Sets like Chaos Rising and Pitch Black have been fan-favorites following their debut, and the trading card game recently celebrated the 30th anniversary of the franchise with the release of Pokemon 's 30th Celebration set , containing reprints of some of the game's most iconic cards. Now, Pokemon TCG fans have an exciting new product to pick up soon.
Pokemon TCG Reveals New Rayquaza Tournament Collection
1 foil promo card featuring Mega Rayquaza ex
3 foil promo cards featuring Zinnia's Trust, Adventure Lantern, and Mega Rayquaza Cap
2 cards that form one Legendary Summit Stadium
65 card sleeves made by Dragon Shield in a thematic box
The Pokemon Company officially revealed the Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection on October 29. The stunning box set features premium accessories from popular TCG accessory company Dragon Shield, including both Mega Rayquaza sleeves and a deck box. Fans picking up the box will get a multitude of foil promo cards, including Mega Rayquaza ex, Zinnia's Trust, Adventure Lantern, Mega Rayquaza Cap, and both halves of the Legendary Summit card. The box also comes with eight booster packs and a code card for rewards on Pokemon TCG Live . Pokemon 's Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection is scheduled to officially release on February 12, 2027.
The newest promo box from Pokemon TCG looks to match perfectly with the game's final set of 2026. Mega Rayquaza ex has already become a mainstay of the competitive game in Japan, typically being included in Mega Kangaskhan ex decks. The promo version of Mega Rayquaza ex also boasts artwork that is not available in the main set of Delta Reign , only featuring the Double Rare and Special Illustration Rare versions. While The Pokemon Company did not mention which packs are available in the collection, the Rayquaza box will likely include booster packs from other sets released throughout 2026, alongside Delta Reign.

With Delta Reign's launch on the horizon, the Pokemon TCG still has another big release coming for its 30th Celebration set. November 6 will mark the official release of the Pokemon TCG 's Day & Night Ultra-Premium Collection , featuring special artwork of Espeon and Umbreon. Each Ultra-Premium Collection also includes a unique Pikachu promo card, printed in the colorful Futuristic Rare treatment first released with the 30th Celebration. The card game also debuted the new Deck Crafter's Collection boxes on October 22, containing a range of staple cards for players to get into the game's competitive scene.
Pokemon will look to follow up a successful 2026 with another big year for the trading card game. The Pokemon Company has already revealed the first new expansion releasing in 2027, with Mega Lucario Z ex headlining the Flowing Fists set. The Pokemon TCG also confirmed a brand-new type of card is being added to the game in a future set, officially teasing the introduction of ex Star cards during the 2026 PokemonXP convention. Between Z Mega Evolutions and ex Star cards, the Pokemon TCG should have something to excite both collectors and players in 2027.
